It is my pleasure to welcome you to the official website of Khowang College. I feel proud and privileged when availing of the opportunity of communicating with you through the website of my college as the Principal. With the vision of creating responsible citizens equipped with the required knowledge and skills, the College also inculcates discipline and character building along with the serious pursuit of knowledge, utilizing the most advanced teaching practices and updating itself with the various technological spreads of time. Khowang College aims to empower students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds through quality education and skill as it believes in overall holistic development of the students. Our faculty and staff work tirelessly to create a nurturing environment that fosters growth, creativity and critical thinking. The College has a eco-friendly campus and well-equipped Central Library suitable for learning and encouraging creative thinking.

FROM THE PRINCIPAL'S DESK
Dr. Trailokya Dehingia
M.A.,M.Phil., Ph.D
WELCOME TO KHOWANG COLLEGE
Khowang College was established on 17th July, 1982 with the faculty of Arts to impart higher
                        education facilities to the poor and backward section of the society. The college has been
                        provincial zed since 2005 and it is affiliated to Dibrugarh University. The college was
                        recognized by the UGC under its sections 2(f) and 12(B) on the 19th October, 2004. The faculty
                        of Commerce of this college was introduced subsequently in 1986, but it is yet to come under
                        government grant-in-aid. The college is located in a rural tribal sub-plan.
Our Goals :
Khowang College has been catering to the higher education needs of vast rural and academically, socially and economically challenged students of Khowang and its neighbouring areas...
Read
                            More
Our Mission:
Khowang College strives for imparting Higher education especially to the desiring and deserving students belonging to socially and economically backward and unprivileged sections of the rural society. Also,it strives to prepare the students to be instrumental for the great process of nation-building and universal brotherhood.
